caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass jug with a narrow neck, a flared rim, and a single curved handle attached from the rim to the shoulder of the jug, with the handle ending in a distinct circular or spiraled embellishment. The jug is rendered in shades of amber and brown, suggesting that the glass is tinted. Light reflections and shading are present on the surface of the jug, giving it a glossy appearance and indicating the transparent quality of the material. The jug sits upright on a plain, light-colored background, and there is a signature in the lower right corner of the drawing. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Glass Jug
